draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.64, the 233rd-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 9th of 11 at TE. He went 97th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (233rd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 108 receiving yards in 2020, 9th of 10 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2023. 34 career games and 12 starts over 3 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (9th percentile). Played 6 of 17 games in 2023.
